visualTreatment.emphasisMethod: Natural phrase boundaries, no word bouncing or independent factual highlights.
visualTreatment.backdrop: Clear charcoal lower reading field; no box.
visualTreatment.animation: Four-frame opacity entrance/exit, fixed glyph locations.
visualTreatment.rationale: Stable readable speech supports changing narrative setting without competing equipment labels.
